purpose: Evidence-backed qualitative classification of Candidate-v7 confirmatory false abstentions and false retrievals after Candidate-v8 architecture hypotheses and development protocol were preregistered.
why_access_was_necessary: Aggregate statistics establish 7 answerable false abstentions and 10 no-evidence false retrievals but cannot identify causal language/structure classes. Semantic inspection is required only to validate or reject preregistered root-cause hypotheses.
permanent_exclusions: candidate-v8 architecture selection after diagnostic classification
